title: Extension of scalars on bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime, let $E\subseteq\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ be a finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $X$ be a scheme. Let
$$
\varphi\colon\cO_{E,X}\longrightarrow E_X
$$
be the coefficient-ring morphism of [def-sfb-integers-to-subfield], and write
$D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$ and
$D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ for the bounded constructible full subcategories of
$D(\Mod_{\cO_{E,X}})$ and $D(\Mod_{E_X})$, respectively [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. By
[lem-sfb-extend-scalars-bounded-constructible], the derived extension-of-scalars functor [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]
$$
L(\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi)=E_X\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_{E,X}}-
$$
restricts to a functor
$$
E\otimes^{\mathrm L}_{\cO_E}-\colon D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)\to
D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E).
$$
Define this restricted functor as $\operatorname{boundedConstructibleExtendScalars}(X,\ell,E)$. Its
composite with the inclusion of $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},E)$ into
$D(\Mod_{E_X})$ is equipped with the canonical isomorphism to the composite of the inclusion of
$D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\cO_E)$ into $D(\Mod_{\cO_{E,X}})$ with
$L(\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi)$, namely
$\operatorname{boundedConstructibleExtendScalarsCompatibility}(X,\ell,E)$.
Explicitly, writing $T=L(\operatorname{Ext}_\varphi)$, this restriction sends an object $K$ to $T(K)$, equipped with bounded constructibility from [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-bounded-constructible], and sends a morphism $u$ to $T(u)$ in the target full subcategory. The compatibility isomorphism has component $\operatorname{id}_{T(K)}$ at every $K$.
